issue.title: test_selected_gate_shell_output_png_snapshot fails: gate output lines never render
issue.description: Visual snapshot test tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_family_panel_gate.py::test_selected_gate_shell_output_png_snapshot fails at assert_page_svg_contains(page, 'gate output line 01') after scrolling #agent-prompt-scroll to y=16 and visual idle. The settling gate shell ('Run deployment preview' renders; its long output with 'gate output line 01'/'truncated' never appears in the exported SVG). Found while implementing the approved Agents-tilde-neighbor removal plan (202609/remove_agents_tilde_neighbor_keymap.md); the failure blocks full just fix-tui-screenshots runs because the maintenance runner refuses all golden writes when the child pytest exits nonzero.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails 3/3 on the working tree AND 1/1 on a pristine stash of the same master commit 42acc2979 (verified via git stash baseline), so it is independent of the neighbor-removal changes. Two sibling failures in the same full run (waiting zoom modal timeout, context lanes drift) passed on targeted rerun, but this node fails standalone (.venv/bin/python -m pytest -m visual, 8s call, direct assertion failure, not a timeout).

evidence.note: Independent reproduction from epic sase-11y.10.1.7 phase sase-11y.10.1.7.6 (docs-surfaces; PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1, 2026-09-21T09:26Z): test_selected_gate_shell_output_png_snapshot failed on a clean tree during a full just fix-tui-screenshots run (972 pass, 0 goldens changed, this node the lone failure; gate output scroll assertion). Master at the time was 2328b07ab, i.e. after 42acc2979, so the failure persists across the service-host-sunset commits and is unrelated to them. Routed here by the sase-11y.10.1.7 land agent.

Independent reproduction plus a bisect by the sase-14n land agent on athena (2026-09-21). The node is the only failure in a full just test-visual at master 87c604833 (969 passed, 1 failed), and it also fails in a targeted just test-visual of the file. git bisect run between ec7dbbfdf (good) and 87c604833 (bad), running the single node with -m '' in a detached worktree, names 4255afbb0 'fix(usage): count built-in size-alias pools as provider references' as the first bad commit. Every later probe also fails, including 13467a570, which pins usage-refresh fallback and proc observer off in the PNG harness and so did not cure this node. Likely lead: 4255afbb0 makes Muse usage-eligible, so a host-dependent usage-refresh surface changes the Agents layout and the fixed scroll_to(y=16) no longer lands on the gate output. This is unrelated to epic sase-14n.

Proposed by sase-14y.2 (notes #1 and #7, 2026-09-21): gate-scroll assertion 'gate output line 01' failed identically on the pristine tree; the takeover agent could not bank this golden after a full fix-tui-screenshots run plus 2 solo retries at master ~dd1d49bf5. Routed by sase-14y land agent.

Independent reproduction 2026-09-22 on master 1404010b1 while implementing the approved Agents status row polish plan (202609/agents_status_row_polish.md): node fails standalone (1/1 targeted) and in full runs (6 failed incl. this node), and fails identically with all tracked polish changes stashed, so it is independent of the status-row work. Viewport probe shows the output section's lines render blank in exported SVG while 'truncated' marker paints; prompt.content text contains all 23 lines. Blocks full just fix-tui-screenshots (runner refuses all golden writes on nonzero child exit).
